title: 3 Free AI Tools That Feel Illegal to Know
description: Three free AI tools that save hours every week: one for writing, one for meetings, one for images. Follow for a new tech tip every day. #shorts #ai #aitools #productivity #techtips

scenes.narration: These three free AI tools will save you hours every single week.
Number one: Claude. Paste a messy email or report and ask it to rewrite it clearly. It is great with long documents.
Number two: NotebookLM from Google. Upload your notes or PDFs and it answers questions using only your sources.
It can even turn your documents into a podcast style audio summary you can listen to on the go.
Number three: Canva's Magic tools. Type what you want and get social posts, slides, and thumbnails in seconds.
Try one today. Follow for a new tech tip every day.
